question: Is GRU hidden[49] significantly better than Encoder[49] across benchmark sessions?
comparison: held-out corrected mean R2, GRU minus Encoder

decision.interpretation: Overall paired evidence supports GRU, but the effect is not individually significant in every session.

methodology.per_session: 1,000 reach-level bootstrap repetitions from each saved Phase-12 run
methodology.cross_session: unweighted session effect; 100,000 session bootstrap repetitions
methodology.primary_test: exact one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank over six paired session deltas
methodology.why_not_bin_level: adjacent bins within a reach are autocorrelated and not independent experimental units
methodology.multiple_comparison_note: per-session intervals are exploratory and unadjusted; the cross-session pair is prespecified
